scenario.zh: 某碳信用项目需要追踪5000公顷稻田的减排效果，验证农户是否按约定管理水位
scenario.en: A carbon credit project needs to track emissions reduction across 5,000 hectares of rice fields

instruction.zh: 确定本次监测的地理范围和数据源
instruction.en: Define geographic scope and data sources

label.zh: 雷达影像 + 抽样地面验证

output.zh: 已配置：卫星雷达全覆盖，每200公顷1个地面传感器，监测周期14天
output.en: Configured: Full radar coverage with 1 ground sensor per 200 hectares, 14-day cycle

label.zh: 仅雷达影像（无地面数据）

output.zh: 已配置：仅卫星雷达数据，无地面验证，适用于初步筛查阶段
output.en: Configured: Satellite radar only, no ground validation, suitable for initial screening

instruction.zh: 调整雷达反射强度阈值，判定稻田是否处于淹水状态
instruction.en: Adjust radar backscatter threshold to classify field flooding status

output.zh: 淹水判定更保守，减少误报但可能漏检边缘地块，适合正式核查
output.en: Conservative classification reduces false positives but may miss edge cases, suited for audits

output.zh: 淹水判定更宽松，覆盖更多潜在区域但可能产生误报，适合早期预警
output.en: Permissive classification captures more areas but may include false positives, suited for early alerts

instruction.zh: 查看不同管理措施下的淹水时长和合规情况
instruction.en: Review flooding duration and compliance under different management practices

output.zh: 全年淹水天数较高，土壤长期厌氧，甲烷排放基线水平
output.en: High flooding days year-round, prolonged anaerobic soil conditions, baseline methane emission

output.zh: 淹水天数明显减少，干湿交替明显，符合项目减排要求
output.en: Flooding days notably reduced, clear wet-dry cycles, meets project emission reduction targets

instruction.zh: 汇总监测数据，形成碳信用项目的核查依据
instruction.en: Consolidate monitoring data for carbon credit project verification

output.zh: 报告包含：地块合规率、淹水天数时序图、雷达与地面数据对比、减排估算依据
output.en: Report includes: field compliance rate, flooding timeline, radar vs ground data, emission reduction basis

output.zh: 已标记37处地块：淹水模式与协议不符，需人工现场核查或农户访谈
output.en: 37 fields flagged: flooding pattern deviates from agreement, requires field inspection or farmer interview

takeaway.zh: GeoAI监测让碳信用项目从抽查变为全覆盖，雷达影像结合地面验证可快速定位管理问题
takeaway.en: GeoAI monitoring shifts carbon credit projects from sampling to full coverage, combining radar and field data to pinpoint management issues

initial.zh: 项目周期：2025年1月-12月 | 地块：5000公顷 | 目标：验证间歇灌溉实施情况与甲烷减排
initial.en: Period: Jan-Dec 2025 | Area: 5,000 ha | Goal: Verify intermittent flooding and methane reduction
